title: Suspicious Claim Activity – Immediate Protection Request – Civil Customer
background: You received a notification about a medical claim that does not match any treatment you had.
customer_goal: Protect your policy from misuse, open a fraud dispute, and understand monitoring and next steps.

conversation.customer_msg: Hello, I just got an alert for a medical claim I don't recognize. I think someone used my insurance details.
conversation.actor_intent: Report suspicious claim and trigger urgency. Maintain politeness and cooperative tone.
conversation.advice_instructional: Acknowledge concern, verify identity, then apply immediate policy protection controls.

conversation.customer_msg: Yes, of course. {{customer_name}}, {{customer_dob_human}}, and I live at {{customer_address_street}} in {{customer_address_city}}.
conversation.actor_intent: Provide verification information. Maintain politeness and cooperative tone.
conversation.advice_instructional: Confirm verification and place protective flag/lock as per policy.

conversation.customer_msg: I have not had any treatment this month. The claim says it was submitted two days ago.
conversation.actor_intent: Provide timeline and inconsistency evidence. Maintain politeness and cooperative tone.
conversation.advice_instructional: Capture incident details and determine investigation scope.

conversation.customer_msg: Could you please open a fraud investigation and mark this claim as disputed.
conversation.actor_intent: Request formal dispute initiation. Maintain politeness and cooperative tone.
conversation.advice_instructional: Open fraud dispute, explain case handling stages and expected contact points.

conversation.customer_msg: Can you also add extra protection so no other suspicious claims go through unnoticed?
conversation.actor_intent: Request containment beyond single claim. Maintain politeness and cooperative tone.
conversation.advice_instructional: Apply temporary watch/protection notes and explain what they do.

conversation.customer_msg: Can this be fully resolved today? I'm worried this will affect me immediately.
conversation.actor_intent: Test boundary on immediate resolution. Maintain politeness and cooperative tone.
conversation.advice_instructional: Set realistic timeline; no guaranteed same-day final decision; provide immediate safeguards and monitoring.

conversation.customer_msg: Then please notify me by email whenever anything changes.
conversation.actor_intent: Set communication channel preferences. Maintain politeness and cooperative tone.

conversation.customer_msg: What should I do if I see another suspicious claim before you finish the review?
conversation.actor_intent: Elicit contingency guidance. Maintain politeness and cooperative tone.
conversation.advice_instructional: Provide clear contingency instructions and escalation route.

conversation.customer_msg: Thank you. Could you summarize what you've done and the expected review timeline?
conversation.actor_intent: Require structured recap. Maintain politeness and cooperative tone.
conversation.advice_instructional: Recap lock/flag actions, investigation initiation, communications setup, and timeline.

behavioral_condition.instruction: Customer remains respectful and cooperative throughout.
escalation_cues: Agent does not immediately acknowledge the potential identity misuse
Agent fails to explain what protective measures are being applied
Agent gives no clear ownership of the investigation or next contact point
deescalation_cues: Agent confirms a protective flag/lock has been placed on the policy
Agent provides a case reference and explains investigation stages
Agent gives concrete contingency instructions for new suspicious activity

reveal_when_asked: The suspicious claim was filed by a provider clinic in a city you have never visited.
You have not shared your insurance card or policy number with anyone.
Your insurance card is still in your wallet — it was not lost or stolen.
You last used your insurance for a routine GP check-up three weeks ago.
You received the alert via the insurer's mobile app notification.
must_ask_checkpoints: Can this be fully resolved today?
How exactly will I be notified of progress?
What should I do if another suspicious claim appears?
